name: Tamweel Aloula
verdict: Saudi financing company presented among AlKifah Holding's financial-services investments. Nothing found.
note: Arabic brand name تمويل الأولى. Al-Fateh's 'Main Sponsor' per the club's partners page; its logo runs across the upper back of the 2026/27 home shirt, and the club's stadium is named Maydan Tamweel Aloula. Rating note: AlKifah Holding's website presents Tamweel AlOula under its financial-services investments; AlKifah is a private Eastern Province group whose overview says it was established in 1970 by Sheikh Hassan Al Afaleq. Tamweel Aloula itself is licensed by the Saudi Central Bank as a single-person (closed) joint-stock company; its site does not name the shareholder. No state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
